fetch_accel.name: 令牌桶節流
fetch_accel.mech: FRED 120 req/min 官方上限→預設 100/min;跨工人共享鎖

fetch_accel.name: 從新往舊視窗
fetch_accel.mech: observation_end 游標倒序+sort_order=desc;視窗長依頻率

fetch_accel.name: checkpoint 續跑
fetch_accel.mech: 每視窗落盤即記 oldest 游標;中斷零浪費;DONE 不重抓

fetch_accel.name: anti-join 冪等
fetch_accel.mech: DuckDB INSERT … WHERE NOT EXISTS(date,series);重跑不重複

fetch_accel.name: typed schema
fetch_accel.mech: date DATE/value DOUBLE/fetched_at TIMESTAMP;既存 VARCHAR 表=顯式 CAST 相容

fetch_accel.name: parquet 每序列
fetch_accel.mech: macro/fred/<id>.parquet zstd;讀寫局部化(單序列更新不重寫全量)

fetch_accel.name: polars 鏡
fetch_accel.mech: us_macro_all.parquet 以 polars 合併排序;缺=pyarrow 後備(誠實)

fetch_accel.name: 韌性 HTTP
fetch_accel.mech: SUP_MDL740.http_json→Aegis ResilientHTTPClient(retry/backoff/TLS)

fetch_accel.name: 同意閘先行
fetch_accel.mech: VIA_NET_CONSENT/VIA_SCRAPE_CONSENT fail-closed

fetch_accel.name: 動態進度條
fetch_accel.mech: 序列級 [■■□] n/N %·已耗·預估;每序列 flush 即時

fetch_accel.name: 非阻塞輸出
fetch_accel.mech: 逐行 flush;可由啟動器/工人分離尾讀(Invoke-VIA-Complete)

fetch_accel.name: 視窗即落盤
fetch_accel.mech: 每視窗 rows→parquet+duckdb;不等全序列

fetch_accel.name: 最新 vintage
fetch_accel.mech: realtime_start/end 預設今日(最新修訂值)

fetch_accel.name: 缺值過濾
fetch_accel.mech: FRED '.' 缺值不入庫;value 轉 float 失敗即棄

fetch_accel.name: 增量刷新
fetch_accel.mech: DONE 序列只抓 max_date−45d 修訂窗(快)

fetch_accel.name: 叢集排序
fetch_accel.mech: parquet 寫入前 ORDER BY series,date;DuckDB 掃描 zone-map 有效

fetch_accel.name: 誠實三態+序列冊
fetch_accel.mech: OK/FAIL/SKIP/EMPTY;macro_series_registry 記 min/max/n/state

fetch_accel.name: 資料家接點
fetch_accel.mech: output_hub=MDL123 Junction→本機資料家;印實體路徑

rules: 只增不減:對映冊不合併不取代現役;最佳化=並存 *_typed/parquet 鏡;原表零 DROP
